Are you precise, technically minded, and do you enjoy working with your hands? 
Over het werk 
For the Sealing & Polymer department, we are looking for an enthusiastic Prep & Finish Operator. You will join a dynamic team where quality, precision, and collaboration are key. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that products are carefully prepared and finished, meeting the highest quality standards. 
As a Prep & Finish Operator, you are responsible for various activities within the production process. During the prep phase, you clean metal parts using special fluids, sandblast components to optimally prepare the surface, clean them again, and apply a primer. During the finish phase, you use ice blasting to complete the final treatment of the products before they move on to the next stage of the process. You work accurately according to established quality guidelines and, together with your colleagues, ensure that every product is delivered in perfect condition.

Olympia 
 Purchasing officer | Aircraft maintenance 
 - 
 Wat ga je doen? 
Are you creative enough to source parts that almost no one else can find? 
As a Purchasing Officer, you are responsible for sourcing all required parts for a single aircraft, from A to Z. This is not a role focused on routine purchasing or recurring orders. Your challenge is to track down critical aircraft parts when the source is unknown, supply is limited, or availability is extremely scarce. For you, "impossible" is not an option. If a manufacturer cannot deliver a part for several months, you proactively explore alternative solutions; for example, by creatively reallocating components from other aircraft undergoing maintenance. 
You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of B1 Licensed Aircraft Engineers, B2 Avionics Engineers, and the Planning Department to ensure maintenance projects stay on schedule. In addition, you will meet with clients once or twice a week to provide updates on part availability and sourcing progress. This role requires persistence, creativity, strong communication skills, and the ability to think beyond conventional procurement methods to keep aircraft flying. 
 Waar ga je werken? 
You'll be working for a leading, independent aircraft maintenance organization in the Maastricht region. You'll be working right alongside the aircraft, as part of an international team with short lines of communication. It's a full-time position.
